title: Framework adoption and basic pattern foundation
goal: Make Techies Starter Framework Primitives and Semantic Roles the visual source for every techies.tools route, then publish the first reusable basic patterns.

nodes.title: Audit Framework adoption
nodes.goal: Map route, shell, token, persistence, and existing pattern boundaries before production changes.
deliverables: Framework adoption audit and recommended boundary
acceptanceChecks: Every current route and shared shell is classified
Live Preview values remain distinct from stable app chrome

nodes.title: Adopt Framework tokens site-wide
nodes.goal: Publish canonical Starter Framework variables globally and migrate shared application surfaces away from independent palette values.
deliverables: Migrated shared app chrome and Changelog
acceptanceChecks: Every route receives canonical Framework variables
App chrome does not load editable Element Treatments
Existing routes retain usable contrast and layout

nodes.title: Build first basic patterns
nodes.goal: Extract and publish Button, Badge, Card, and Clickable card patterns using Framework variables.
acceptanceChecks: Patterns use semantic HTML and canonical Framework variables
Desktop and mobile layouts have no horizontal overflow

nodes.title: Verify Framework and patterns
nodes.goal: Verify functionality, accessibility contracts, responsive geometry, tests, check, build, and exact final diff.
acceptanceChecks: Desktop and mobile real-browser checks pass
No unresolved blocking diff finding remains
